2 Stonecrest Sparrow Ocular Tuners,  1 Herragath Hollow Crest
Rarity
Crafting Time
16
Echo Crest
Tinkers Tools
Rare
Supplies: 2
2 Days Focused
With an off putting echo, the hollow crest resonates and returns the surrounding sounds.
Returning Call By releasing your grip on the ocular tuners, the Hollow Crest can 
instantly repeats any sound it hears immediately. If used near a Beast within 30 
ft. you have Advantage on Animal Handling and Intimidation checks against that 
creature for 1 minute.
DC
Tool Proficiency
2 Lhoupin Loop Ears, 1 Khanith Rigid Wing
Rarity
Crafting Time
16
Whisper Ring [9.]
Woodcarver's Tools
Rare
Supplies: 1
1 Day Focused
A delicate wooden ring harnesses the precise hearing honed by millions of years of evolution.
Khani Vibrations While using the Whisper Ring, you have Advantage on 
Perception checks that rely on hearing, allowing you to detect faint heart beats 
and breathing of hidden and invisible creatures within 30 ft..
Hyper Acute While using the Whisper Ring, you have Vulnerability to Thunder 
damage.
DC
Tool Proficiency
4 Esslinter Razored Fin-Ray and 32 Glass Teeth
Rarity
Crafting Time
16
Twin Grip Gloves
Leatherworker's Tools
Rare
Supplies: 2
1 Day Focused
Bladed fin-rays fitted to the side of two leather mittens, the gloves bite in deep when gripping.
Cutting Hook The wearer has Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to 
Grapple a creature and inflicts 1d4 Slashing damage to the grappled creature at 
the start the wearers turn as long as the Grapple is maintained.  
Toothed Grip With an interior lined with esslinter teeth you cannot wield 
weapons effectively while wearing these gloves, though you gain an additional 
1d4 Slashing damage to Unarmed Strikes.
DC
Tool Proficiency
 2 Basilospri Wings
Rarity
Crafting Time
17
Ospri Glider
Blacksmith's Tools
Rare
Supplies: 4
2 Days Focused
With stitched wings outstretched, one is a step closer to experiencing the freedom of flight.
Taking Off Requires an elevated position to launch from. 
Glide With wings extended and straps secured, you can glide up to 5 ft. 
horizontally in any direction for every 1 ft. you fall. You descend 60 ft. per round 
and take no damage from falling while gliding in this way. If damage is taken 
during the glide, you must perform a DC 12 Athletics check. Failure: You lose 
control of the wings and plummet.
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Shaevrynn Reflective Fur, 1 Vinnirex Tidal Furred Hide
Rarity
Crafting Time
17
Hideaway Pack
Leatherworker's Tools
Rare
Supplies: 3
2 Days Focused
Kept hidden and safe, the reactive fur blends into the surroundings seamlessly.
Protected Pack The Hideaway Pack can hold 1 cubic foot / 30 pounds of gear and 
is waterproof. 
Reactive Wear While wearing this, you have +1 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) 
Saving Throws. 
Easily Missed The camouflaged fur allows the pack to easily escape notice from 
those who had not placed it. A Hideaway Pack left aside is hard to discern from 
the environment around it. DC 18 Wisdom (Perception) check is needed to find it.
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Murrow Sensory Barbel and 1 Rubbery Hide
Rarity
Crafting Time
17
Unseen Sighters [5.]
Leatherworker's Tools
Rare
Supplies: 3
2 Days Focused
After a moment of quiet darkness, the wearer begins to see in a new light.
Blind Truth While wearing the Unseen Sighters you are blind to natural vision. 
You instead visually perceive vibrations for up to 120 ft., but are effectively blind 
passed that, and cannot perceive colors or written text. You can Detect Illusions 
and automatically succeed on Saving Throws against them, you have Advantage 
on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to detect hidden or stealth creatures, 
and see through disguises of any kind. While wearing the goggles, you have 
Vulnerability to Thunder damage.
DC
Tool Proficiency
3 Lunegrove Leaves, 1 Gomitoad Lunegrove Extract and 6 Gomi Skins
Rarity
Crafting Time
18
Lunegrove Pouch [6.]
Leatherworker's Tools
Very Rare
Supplies: 3
3 Days Focused
Vibrantly color hints to danger, be careful when placing ammo in the glistening interior.
The lunegrove pouch can hold up to 5 darts, blowgun needles, crossbow bolts, or 
arrows or equivalent ammunition at a time. After 10 minutes within the pouch, 
the ammunition is imbued with the effects of lunegrove toxin.  
Lunegrove Toxin When you hit a creature with imbued ammunition. Constitution 
Saving Throw, DC 16, the creature hit by the toxin imbued weapons. Failure: 3 (1d6) 
Poison damage and has the Poison condition for one minute. The creature can 
repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself 
with a successful save. While poisoned, the creature is compelled to attack the 
immediate nearest creature, whether it is a friend or foe.
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Streamweed Strand, 6 Tiama Fin Spines, 1 Jhotus Curled Tusk
Rarity
Crafting Time
17
Scavenger's Call
Tinker's Tools
Rare
Supplies: 2
1 Day Focused
A low droning call carries through the Wealdwoods, felt in the chest more than the ears.
Call to Feast With a Utilize Action you can blow into the Scavenger's Call horn, 
creating a deep resonating call that alerts most scavengers within a 600 ft. radius 
of your position. The Keeper then immediately rolls on the Scavengers Table 
for the current biome and the resulting creatures arrives within 1d10 minutes, 
gravitating towards the scent of any nearby carcass within 30 ft. of where the 
call was made.
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Pint of Infernoil, 1 Dross Grass Thread, 2 Tiama Gill Fans , 1 Illithisk Urchin Pillar
Rarity
Crafting Time
16
Symbion Smoke [7.]
Alchemist Supplies
Rare
Supplies: 3
1 Day Focused
Inhaling the salty smoke, the mind expands and the soft pulse of overwhelming connections. 
Symbiosis Senses When lit, smoke fills a 10 by 10 ft. Sphere from the lamp and 
burns for 1 hour. When a creature inhales the smoke it gains the ability to read 
the primal surface emotions of all Medium or larger creatures within 400 ft., 
regardless of walls or obstacles. This allows the inhaler to sense the creature’s 
emotional state, general direction, and gives the inhaler Advantage to any 
Charisma based skill checks on creatures they can sense within the radius. The 
effect lasts for 10 minutes and a creature can only be affected by it once per day.
DC
Tool Proficiency
2 Vinnirex Golden Orbs, 1 Krainis Split Tongue
Rarity
Crafting Time
18
Eyes of Kin [10.]
Alchemist’s Supplies
Very Rare
Supplies: 3
1/2 Day Focused
10 Days Patient
The primal connection of being one with a pack can survive beyond death.
After placing one Eye of Kin dried eye into your mouth, you will be able to perceive 
the vision of another creature that has the paired Eye of Kin within their own 
mouth from one of your eyes. The effect is lost with the removal of the dried eye 
from either creature's mouth. Trigger: When each creature that has an Eye of Kin 
within their mouth looks at each other. Response - Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, both 
creatures. Failure: The creature has the Incapacitated condition for 10 minutes.
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Basket Cotton Clump, 1 Omaterssum Pouch Hide, 1 Draffer Woolly Hide
1 Dulleyed Cattail, 1 Trawlauth Bacterial Pipe and 1 Suffocating Sludge, 1 
Gharril Oculoid
Rarity
Crafting Time
15
Kit Kradle [8.]
Leatherworker's Tools
Rare
Supplies: 3
2 Days Focused
Like a mother, the carrier's soft pouch lining provides a warm welcoming embrace.
Creature Carrier You can place a single Small or smaller Creature into the Kit 
Cradle. Animal Handling (Wisdom) check: DC 16. Success: The creature rests within 
the Kit Cradle for 1 hour before wriggling out. Failure: The creature resists and 
the wearer must wait 1 minute before trying again, any additional attempts are 
made with Disadvantage for 1 hour.
Tiny Tackle As a Bonus Action, you can order the creature resting within it to leave 
and attack another visible creature with 30 ft.. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, target 
creature. Failure: The target takes 7 (2d6) Piercing Damage. Once out, you must 
perform the Creature Carrier Action to place the Creature back within the Kit Cradle.
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Streamweed Strand, 2 Acrynn Hollow Antennae, 4 Lanceleth Muggy Antenna
Rarity
Crafting Time
15
Darkling Band
Leatherworker's Tools
Uncommon
Supplies: 3
1 Day Focused
The tremor sensing antennae of two blind beasts, resonates with a kind of vibrating sight.
Quiver Step While wearing the Darkling Band, you gain Tremorsense of up to 
60 ft., and through a weak form of echolocation, you can perceive the direction 
and proximity of large objects and walls in total darkness within 30 ft..  
Danger Sense While wearing the Darkling Band headband, you cannot be 
Surprised by concealed creatures within 30 ft. of you. 
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Dross Grass Thread, 1 Maedrynn Moribeak, Slannethiss External Gills
Rarity
Crafting Time
20
Survivor's Thorn
Alchemist's Supplies
Legendary
Supplies: 1
1 Day Focused
A violent means to claim eons of amphibious evolution straight to the blood stream.
Depths Breath With a Utilization Action you may plunge the Thorn into your 
body, dealing 1d4 Piercing damage. For 1 day, you can breath underwater and 
poisonous fumes or other toxic gases as if it was clear air as the external gills 
filter and clean the oxygen directly to your bloodstream.
DC
Tool Proficiency
1 Shaevrynn Thick Whisker, 1 Korrask Feeler Tendril, 1 Gorr Domed Eye, 1 Vial 
of Vigael
Rarity
Crafting Time
15
Heartsought Eye
Leatherworker's Tools
Uncommon
Supplies: 2
2 Days Focused
With layers of sensory reactive leathers surrounding the eye, it throbs like a beating heart 
when creatures approach.
Tremor Beat With a Utilization Action, you can push the Heartsought Eye into 
the ground. Through vibrations in the earth it can to detect the largest terrestrial 
creature within 300 ft. away by vibrating, and does not register any creatures 
within 5 ft.. By placing your hand on it, you can feel the pulse in the direction of 
a creature and read its distance. 1 pulse every 10 seconds is at 300 ft. 1 pulse every 
5 seconds is 200 ft. 1 pulse every 3 seconds is 100 ft. 1 pulse every second is 50 ft..
Trawlbreath Lamp
Supplies: 3
Billowing bacteria disperses like a cloying cloud, congealing in the breather's lungs.
The Trawlbreath Lamp holds enough oil to remain lit for an hour before needing 
to be refilled with 1 Trawlauth Suffocating Sludge.  
Dense Fog While the lamp is lit, it emits a thick undulating blue fog that spreads 
to fill a 30 ft. Sphere centered on the lamp. This area is shrouded in magical 
darkness that Darkvision cannot penetrate.  
Billowing Bacteria Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, any creature that starts its 
turn within the fog. Failure: Target creature begins to suffocate. The creature has 
the Incapacitated condition while within the fog. 
Dispersing the Fog Any wind or gust of air of at least 10 miles per hour can 
disperse the fog in 1 minute.

Tool Proficiency
1 Maedrynn Crested Skull, and 1 Darting Tongue, 1 Taurachni Book Lungs
Rarity
Crafting Time
23
Mori Crest
Leatherworker's Tools
Legendary
Supplies: 1
1 Day Focused
Pressing the book lungs along the small hollow skull releases a loud piercing screech, and 
within moment, one can hear a distant echoing screech in kind.
Summoning Crest If you are in an open outdoor space, you can take a Utilize 
Action to press the Crest. Doing so summons 3d6 maedrynn birds (pg. 
99). These maedrynn flock to you and obey your commands for 1 day. They 
understand simple attacks such as, "attack this", "fly there", "protect me", etc. 
Mini Murmuration As an Action you can order the humming birds to attack a 
target creature within 60 ft. that you can see. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, the 
target creature. Failure: 18 (3D6+8) Slashing damage. Success: Half damage.
